correctness.rationale: Any restrained dominating D must meet each clique; then domination of remaining vertices is automatic, while no isolated omitted vertices requires complement singleton only at a bridge endpoint with the other endpoint omitted. Exhaustive disjoint complement cases give C_n(q)^2 plus bridge-rescue configurations; inverse-variable transform yields exact formula and min layer. Independently enumerated all vertex subsets for n=3,4,5,6: valid 21,134,705,3310 respectively, and n² minimum sets; original verification extends n=3..8. The structural proof covers every n≥3 and the fixed bridge geometry.
